meta.notes: G Mining Ventures 2025 Feasibility Study golden fixture. All economic series are the rounded annual values published in Tables 22.3 and 22.6; no balancing item or inferred royalty allocation is used. Operating costs retain Table 22.3 Total OPEX plus its separately reported Y1 land payment; Y-1 uses Table 22.6 after the published transfer of pre-production costs to initial capital. The aggregate rows are used because the report does not publish annual open-pit/underground royalty production splits.

constructionStart.pageOrTable: Section 24.2 pp.24-2–24-5: early works began March 2025

productionStart.pageOrTable: Sections 1.24 p.1-30 and 24.2 pp.24-2–24-5: commissioning begins Q3 2027
productionStart.notes: Maps the report's Y-1 commissioning production to calendar 2027.

nameplateCapacity.pageOrTable: Sections 1.24 p.1-30 and 24.2 pp.24-2–24-5: commercial production starts January 2028

runtimePlacement.notes: Report-sourced placement: Y-3=2025, Y-2=2026, Y-1=2027 commissioning, Y1=2028 commercial production. The relative Table 22.6 series is not shifted.

taxModel.notes: REPORT: exact rounded Taxes row from Table 22.6. RUNTIME: Section 22.10 states a 25% corporate tax rate; the runtime proxy applies that nominal rate with loss carryforward. The report's five-year straight-line depreciation and opening US$148.2M tax asset pool are not reconstructed because annual depreciation is not published.

report.assumptionsNotes: Real H1-2025 USD, no escalation; US$2,500/oz gold; 5% annual discount rate with t=0 at Y-3; 7 Mtpa saprolite/blend then 6 Mtpa hard-rock plant; five-month ramp-up; 12.3 operating years; 25% corporate tax; five-year straight-line depreciation; US$148.2M opening tax asset pool; 8% NSR on open-pit gold and 3% NSR on underground gold. Table 22.6 includes US$69M pre-production EBITDA in Y-1, reports initial capital before that benefit, and publishes the resulting project cash flow directly. The operating-cost series uses Table 22.3 Total OPEX and adds the separately published US$21.7M Y1 land payment; Y-1 follows Table 22.6 after its explicit transfer to capital. Rounded report values create at most sub-US$1M annual differences; no balancing item is introduced.

reportedCostCheckpoints.definitionNotes: LOM total operating cost per payable ounce, including royalties.
